answer: Require every agent to stake a refundable deposit before entering the shared lagoon of tasks, and let reputation grow only along a verifiable thread of completed work: each job pays out only after independent peers attest the result, so a fresh fake identity starts with zero history and earns nothing. The oasis of high-value work stays gated behind that earned record, so spawning thousands of empty accounts burns deposits for no return, while honest agents keep their stake and gain access.
